Hey there! Welcome to the very first release of Snapgrove. 🥳

Snapgrove was created to solve a problem we all secretly deal with: endless folders overflowing with screenshots, receipts, memes, and UI design references, with zero clue where anything is.

This initial stable release gives you:
- Fast, local-first image and screenshot organizing with zero tracking or telemetry.
- Seamless directory browsing with smart nested subfolders that act like tags.
- High-performance Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) batch operations so moving 50 screenshots feels instantaneous.
- Encrypted local bin with automatic 30-day cleanup.
- Pure AMOLED dark theme and crisp light theme with reactive frosted-glass blur.

Hope it saves your sanity like it did ours. Enjoy organizing! 😎
